Last Thursday pt call, say he will "go to my brother in Seattle". Brother Dawit Tesfaye, (206) 555-0183. He want care at Cascadia Regional Oncology Group, Seattle, WA. Wife say not decided. 3/28: NO SHOW for surgery consult and nobody answer (651) 555-0172. Called wife (651) 555-0199, she say pt "not feeling well, maybe go to Seattle after Christmas Eve"?? unclear, she mean Easter probably. 4/2: Records transfer request received by fax from Cascadia, fax (206) 555-0129, release form ROI-2071-04418 signed Yonas Tesfaye (old name!) - ask pt to re-sign with current legal name Jonas Abbey. Sent CT 03/04/71, path report, colonoscopy of 02/22/2071 by Dr Farah Nasrallah. Copy-forward from 3/14: "Pt denies heart problem, wife correct him, BP 118/74" (stale, not this visit).
